title: offset axis re-measured from scratch on the C5_B3 base — block iteration repair + full k x target re-sweep + beta refit

conversion.caveat: every Brier here is full precision, so the +-0.20 rounding caveat does NOT apply

gate1_block_bit_identity.what: exp_031 u2023 s42 stage-3 prediction vs exp_030 u2023 s42 stage-1 prediction.  exp_030's stage 1 ALREADY stopped on its own curve, so the two are the same arithmetic; a mismatch means block_self.py's derivation or the 4-wide CPU contention changed the fit.

gate4_label_isolation.note: no model is fitted here; the design matrix is exp_030's and the recovered labels are TARGETS ONLY there (b3_cat.py asserts it before every frame).  check (b) below is this file's own.

gate5_asof_independent.method: row_id -> season re-read from train.csv in a SECOND pass; the max season of the CONTRIBUTING ROW IDS is looked up in that independent map

stage_A_block_repair.question: after regenerating the blocks under their OWN early stop, does C5_B3 still lose to LGBM_B3 on the blocks?
stage_A_block_repair.verdict: C5_B3 still LOSES at least one supply block after the repair — the iter policy was not the (only) cause; C5 is weaker on small data, and that bears directly on how much to trust a beta fitted on this supply

old_base_reference.source: exp_028 record of the LGBM_B3 base, quoted for contrast only

surfaces.note: block = Brier on the pooled supply (2022+2023) x (seed 42, seed 7) at the pooled beta.  THE ONLY SELECTION SURFACE.  crossblock = fit one block, score the other.  fold_2024 is DIAGNOSTIC and selects nothing.

declared_self.verdict: interior minimum — the grid brackets it

widened_self.verdict: interior minimum — the grid brackets it

declared_league.verdict: interior minimum — the grid brackets it

widened_league.verdict: interior minimum — the grid brackets it

enclosure.reserve_note: K_RESERVE = [6400, 12800] was computed in the same pass so that an EDGE argmin on the declared grid could be widened without a second run.  The declared surface is the 18 cells of K_GRID; the widened rows are read ONLY to decide enclosure.

block_surface.convention: diff = self - league in Brier; diff < 0 means SELF wins

adoption.rule: 3 seeds same sign AND |mean delta| >= 3 x CONTROL seed std. NOT relaxed.
adoption.label_warning: MULTIPLE_OF_THE_THRESHOLD and MULTIPLE_OF_THE_CONTROL_STD differ by exactly 3x.  They are NOT interchangeable and must never be compared across experiments without checking which one the other experiment reported.

S400_self.policy: seed 42 -> beta fitted on seed 42's blocks, seed 7 -> seed 7's, seed 2024 -> pooled (no block prediction exists for seed 2024)

S400_league.policy: seed 42 -> beta fitted on seed 42's blocks, seed 7 -> seed 7's, seed 2024 -> pooled (no block prediction exists for seed 2024)

quadratic_test.note: Brier(p + beta*d) = E[(p-y)^2] - 2 beta E[d(y-p)] + beta^2 E[d^2] is EXACTLY quadratic in beta whenever the clip never fires.  A non-zero residual therefore means either the clip fired or something else moved.

old_base_surface_side_by_side.warning: TWO DIFFERENT BASES.  exp_029's columns are LGBM_B3 (3 seeds, blocks from exp_022/exp_024); exp_031's are C5_B3 (2 block seeds, blocks regenerated under own early stop).  Rows may be compared for SHAPE only; the Brier levels are not commensurable and must never be pooled.

report_derived.what: every derived quantity report.md quotes that is not already a field elsewhere in this file.  Computed from the fields above; nothing new was measured.

old_base_control_seed_std.source: exp_024/exp_028 record for LGBM_B3, quoted for contrast
